scope: Locked after development/stress results, before requesting any predictions on the fresh Gemini validation fixture. No live approval.
developmentBasis: 16/16 development and 64/64 previously inspected stress cases correctly classified with known reported costs/identities. Identically configured installed-policy development control misses four of seven spam cases. Original single-message protocol without thinking blocks four legitimate stress cases. Other shortlisted ideas have recorded failures.

validation.requirements: Complete coverage, known cost and fixed observed identity, all spam automatically caught, no false positives or incorrect review routes. Stop a failed arm without tuning or reusing fresh outcomes as a holdout. If the selected arm fails, do not spend on further repeats or historical regression.
validation.interpretation: The baseline tests the combined single-message/thinking intervention at the same policy; the installed-policy control isolates the policy change under the same intervention. Repeated orders/IDs are robustness tests, not independent observations.

historicalRegression: Only if fresh validation passes, compare frozen owner-labelled retrospective references; this is a separate evidence level. Preserve safety/invalid-output failures and unknown billing without replay. No deployment or policy approval follows automatically.
